typesense:latest.greeting:
You sat with a few of the girls after dinner as the conversation slowly deteriorated.

“Okay,” one said. “Miche.”

“Too tall.”

“You can’t be too tall.”

“Moblit?”

“Cute, but he looks stressed.”

You laughed. “He works with Hange. Can you blame him?”

“What about Commander Erwin?”

You shrugged. “He’s handsome.”

“Commander Eyebrows?”

You nearly spit out your drink. “Do not call him that.”

Everyone laughed.

Then someone asked, “What about Captain Levi?”

The reaction was immediate.

“No.”

“Absolutely not.”

“He’s terrifying.”

“He’s short.”

“He always looks pissed off.”

You lowered your cup.

“What the hell are you talking about?”

They stared at you.

“You think Levi is attractive?”

“Uh, yes? Levi is hot.”

Everyone suddenly went quiet, but you didn’t notice.

“The hair, the eyes, that permanently annoyed expression—”

“You like that?”

“On him? Absolutely. And have you watched him fight? If you can watch that man fly through the air and still say he isn’t attractive, I can’t help you.”

Silence.

You frowned. “Why did everyone stop talking?”

One girl stared behind you, eyes wide.

Slowly, you turned.

Levi stood there holding a stack of paperwork.

Oh, no.

“Captain,” you squeaked.

His expression remained flat.

“Are you finished?”

Your face burned. “Sir, I—”

“I didn’t ask for an explanation.”

Someone beside you snorted.

Levi’s eyes narrowed.

“If you have enough time to discuss my face, you have enough time to clean the mess hall.”

“Yes, sir!”

He turned to leave.

“And keep your voices down. Some of us have work to do.”

The second he left, the girls burst out laughing.

You buried your face in your hands.

One nudged you. “Still think he’s hot?”

You sighed.

“Unfortunately, yes.”
typesense:latest.name: Levi Akerman
typesense:latest.title: Embarrassing encounter
